get.description: Implements the oEmbed specification (oembed.com) for bunny.net video embed URLs, allowing third-party sites and tools to auto-generate an embeddable player for a pasted video link. url must be a bunny.net player URL for an existing video — either the legacy player (e.g. "https://iframe.mediadelivery.net/embed/{libraryId}/{videoId}") or the new player (e.g. "https://player.mediadelivery.net/embed/{libraryId}/{videoId}") — not an arbitrary link. Only the library ID and video ID segments are read, so /play/ URLs are accepted as well as /embed/ ones. For private libraries, the request must satisfy the library's referer restrictions and, separately, a valid token and expires pair if token authentication is enabled — one does not substitute for the other.

parameters.name: url
parameters.description: The bunny.net player URL of the video to generate oEmbed data for (legacy iframe.mediadelivery.net or new player.mediadelivery.net player). Both /embed/ and /play/ paths are accepted.

parameters.name: maxWidth
parameters.description: Maximum width in pixels for the embedded player; the player is scaled down to fit while preserving aspect ratio.

parameters.name: maxHeight
parameters.description: Maximum height in pixels for the embedded player; the player is scaled down to fit while preserving aspect ratio.

parameters.name: token
parameters.description: Signed access token, required when the video library has token authentication enabled. An allowed referer is checked separately and does not exempt the request from this requirement.

parameters.name: expires
parameters.description: Unix timestamp (seconds) the token is valid until, required when the video library has token authentication enabled.

200.description: The oEmbed data for the video

400.description: The url could not be parsed

401.description: The video's library is private and no valid token/referer was provided

404.description: The url is not a recognized bunny.net player URL, or the video library or video does not exist

widevineEmeRobustness.description: EME robustness string corresponding to WidevineMinClientSecurityLevel (e.g. "SW_SECURE_CRYPTO", "HW_SECURE_DECODE"); null when no minimum level applies.

widevineSdOnlyForL3.description: When true, Widevine L3 (software-only) clients are capped to SD playback while stronger clients play at full quality; overrides WidevineMinClientSecurityLevel when both are set.

maxSoftwareWidevineResolution.description: Maximum vertical resolution allowed for software (L3) Widevine clients when WidevineSdOnlyForL3 is enabled; null otherwise.

zoneTier.description: Pull zone tier associated with this video library (integer enum value).

isPlayable.description: Determines if the video is currently playable using either playlist or original source.

isPlaylistPlayable.description: Determines if the HLS playlist is currently playable.

preferredPlaybackSource.description: Preferred playback source for the current video state.

rememberPlayerPosition.description: Whether the player resumes from the viewer's last watched position.

customCss.description: Custom CSS injected into the player. Only populated when the caller explicitly requests it.

exposeVideoMetadata.description: Whether JSON-LD structured data (schema.org VideoObject markup) is rendered for this video, e.g. for SEO.

enableCompactControls.description: Whether the player uses a compact control bar layout.

viewsChart.description: Shows the number of playback starts over time, with each data point representing the count of view starts in the corresponding UTC interval (hourly or daily). It is available at both the library level (aggregated across all videos) and the video level (for a single video). A playback start is counted once per viewer session per video and empty intervals are shown as zero.

watchTimeChart.description: Shows the cumulative time viewers spent watching over time, with each data point representing total watch time in the corresponding UTC interval (hourly or daily). It is available at both the library level (aggregated across all videos) and the video level (for a single video). Rewatches and repeated visits add to the total and empty intervals are shown as zero.

countryViewCounts.description: Shows the total number of playback starts by country for the selected time range. It is available at both the library level (aggregated across all videos) and the video level (for a single video). Each country’s value reflects unique playback starts per viewer session based on IP geolocation at playback start.

countryWatchTime.description: Shows the total watch time by country for the selected time range. It is available at both the library level (aggregated across all videos) and the video level (for a single video). Values reflect cumulative viewing time (rewatches and repeated visits add to the total) based on IP geolocation at playback start.

engagementScore.description: Indicates how engaging a specific video is on a 0–100 scale based on viewing duration and viewing patterns; higher values reflect stronger viewer retention. Reported at the video level only and may be unavailable when there isn’t enough viewing data.

totalItems.description: The total number of items across all pages matching the query, not just the current page.

currentPage.description: The current page number of the result set (1-based).

itemsPerPage.description: The effective page size after clamping the requested value; the last page may contain fewer items.

items.description: The items on the current page, in the order returned by the query; an empty list if no results match.

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the video will be put

thumbnailTime.description: Video time in ms to extract the main video thumbnail.

collectionId.description: The ID of the collection where the video belongs. Omit/null to leave the current collection unchanged; send an empty string to remove the video from its collection.

chapters.description: The list of chapters available for the video, up to 200. Omit/null to leave existing chapters unchanged; providing a list, including an empty one, fully replaces all existing chapters.

moments.description: The list of moments available for the video, up to 200. Omit/null to leave existing moments unchanged; providing a list, including an empty one, fully replaces all existing moments.

metaTags.description: The meta tags added to the video, up to 50. Omit/null to leave existing tags unchanged; providing a list, including an empty one, fully replaces all existing tags. Setting a tag with Property "description" also updates the video's Description field.

url.description: The URL from which the video will be fetched from.

headers.description: The headers that will be sent along with the fetch request.

title.description: The title that will be set to video. If omitted, the filename from the fetch URL is used instead, falling back to "Fetched Video" if that can't be determined.

data.description: The response payload. Some endpoints also populate this with error details when Success is false — see the endpoint's own response documentation.

valid.description: Denotes whether uploaded captions file was valid

errorList.description: When uploaded file was invalid, will contain errors found

warningList.description: When uploaded file was valid but non-breaking issues were found, will contain issues found

warningMessage.description: UI-friendly summary of warnings found in the uploaded captions file

srclang.description: Not used — the caption's srclang is taken from the srclang route segment instead. Any value sent here is ignored.
srclang.x-deprecatedMessage: Not used — the caption's srclang is taken from the srclang route segment instead. Any value sent here is ignored.

label.description: The text description label for the caption

targetLanguages.description: List of languages that will be used as target languages, use ISO 639-1 language codes.

generateTitle.description: Whether video title should be automatically generated.

generateDescription.description: Whether video description should be automatically generated.

generateChapters.description: Whether video chapters should be automatically generated.

generateMoments.description: Whether video moments should be automatically generated.

sourceLanguage.description: Video source language, use ISO 639-1 language code.

generateTitle.description: Whether video title should be generated.

generateDescription.description: Whether video description should be generated.

generateChapters.description: Whether video chapters should be generated.

generateMoments.description: Whether video moments should be generated.

sourceLanguage.description: (Optional) Video source language, use ISO 639-1 language code.

data.description: The response payload. Some endpoints also populate this with error details when Success is false — see the endpoint's own response documentation.

videoLibraryId.description: The ID of the video library.

availableResolutions.description: Resolutions currently ready to stream for this video.

configuredResolutions.description: Resolutions the video library is configured to encode; may not all exist yet for this video.

playlistResolutions.description: Resolutions declared in the video's HLS master playlist.

storageResolutions.description: Resolutions found as folders in object storage; can diverge from PlaylistResolutions.

mp4Resolutions.description: Resolutions found as MP4 fallback files in object storage.

storageObjects.description: All storage objects found for this video.

oldResolutions.description: Storage folders using the legacy "{width}x{height}" naming, populated only when HasBothOldAndNewResolutionFormat is true.

hasBothOldAndNewResolutionFormat.description: True when storage contains both the legacy "{width}x{height}" folder naming and the current "{height}p" naming for the same video — can happen when a codec was added via API rather than a full re-encode.

hasOriginal.description: Whether the original uploaded source file is present in storage.

resolution.description: The resolution this reference applies to (e.g. "720p").

path.description: The storage path where this resolution's files are found.

data.description: The response payload. Some endpoints also populate this with error details when Success is false — see the endpoint's own response documentation.

encoded.description: Size in bytes of each encoded rendition, keyed by "{resolution}-{codec}" (e.g. "720p-h264"). Videos encoded before the current storage layout can also report legacy "{width}x{height}" resolutions, e.g. "1920x1080-h264".

thumbnails.description: Size in bytes of the video's JPEG thumbnails.

previews.description: Size in bytes of the video's GIF and WEBP previews.

originals.description: Size in bytes of the original uploaded video file.

mp4Fallback.description: Size in bytes of the MP4 fallback rendition.

miscellaneous.description: Size in bytes of everything else: playlists, manifests, captions, audio extracts, etc.

calculatedAt.description: Timestamp when this storage size was calculated (UTC).

codec.description: Output codec name as used by the storage layout (e.g. "h264", "hevc", "vp9", "av1"). Note that h264 is reported as "x264" in VideoModel.OutputCodecs.

resolution.description: Resolution of this rendition (e.g. "720p", "1080p"), or a legacy "{width}x{height}" value for older videos.

size.description: Size of this rendition in bytes.

data.description: The response payload. Some endpoints also populate this with error details when Success is false — see the endpoint's own response documentation.

videoLibraryId.description: The ID of the video library.

resolutionsToDelete.description: Resolutions selected for removal as part of this cleanup, across the HLS playlist, object storage, and MP4 fallback set. Populated even when dryRun is true or an individual deletion fails — see UpdatedAvailableResolutions/ModifiedPlaylist/DeletedStorageObjects for what was actually changed.

resolutionsToDeleteFromPlaylist.description: Resolutions selected for removal from the HLS master playlist. Populated even when dryRun is true.

resolutionsToDeleteFromStorage.description: Resolutions selected for removal from object storage. Populated even when dryRun is true or an individual deletion fails.

resolutionsToDeleteFromMp4.description: Resolutions selected for removal from the MP4 fallback set. Populated even when dryRun is true.

storageObjectsToDelete.description: Storage object paths selected for deletion as part of this cleanup. These are candidates, not confirmations: the list is populated even when dryRun is true or when an individual deletion fails — see DeletedStorageObjects for whether at least one deletion actually succeeded.

availableResolutionsAfter.description: The video's available resolutions after this cleanup.

updatedAvailableResolutions.description: Whether the video's AvailableResolutions field was rewritten as part of this cleanup.

modifiedPlaylist.description: Whether the HLS master playlist was rewritten to remove the deleted resolutions.

deletedStorageObjects.description: Whether at least one of the storage objects in StorageObjectsToDelete was actually deleted (always false when dryRun is true). Individual objects can still have failed to delete — their failures are logged and do not clear this flag — so this confirms the cleanup did something, not that it removed everything listed.

deletedOriginal.description: Whether the original uploaded source file was deleted from storage as part of this operation.

version.description: The oEmbed spec version implemented by this response. Always "1.0".

type.description: The oEmbed resource type. Always "video" for this endpoint.

thumbnail_url.description: The CDN URL of the video's thumbnail image.

thumbnail_width.description: Width in pixels of the thumbnail image. Omitted for custom-uploaded thumbnails, whose dimensions are not known.

thumbnail_height.description: Height in pixels of the thumbnail image. Omitted for custom-uploaded thumbnails, whose dimensions are not known.

width.description: Width in pixels of the embedded player iframe, scaled to fit within maxWidth/maxHeight while preserving the video's aspect ratio.

height.description: Height in pixels of the embedded player iframe, scaled to fit within maxWidth/maxHeight while preserving the video's aspect ratio.

html.description: The HTML <iframe> markup required to embed the video player.

provider_name.description: The name of the embed provider. Always "bunny.net".

provider_url.description: The URL of the embed provider. Always "https://bunny.net/".
